chunks: They have found the guidance of their Lord and they are the successful ones.

key_terms.أُولَٰئِكَ: Those (demonstrative pronoun referring to a specific group)

ai.seo_question: Who are considered the truly successful according to this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as referring specifically to the Ahl al-Bayt and the Imams, who are the ultimate bearers of divine guidance (Huda). It establishes that true success (Falah) is not merely worldly prosperity but spiritual salvation achieved through adherence to the Prophet's household, reinforcing the concept of Wilayah as the path to divine favor.
